# clearglass-accounts
## Generated by loom/templates/system-scaffold.js
**Version:** 0.1.0
**Generated:** 2026-07-02T07:51:45.115Z
**Purpose:** Account manager for ClearGlass — multiple accounts per provider, usage-threshold detection, dynamic routing when an account nears its limit. Storage delegated to cos/vaultd (already built, encrypted, access-controlled) — not reimplemented here. cos/vaultd defaults to port 3750, which collides with NEXUS copilot — must be redeployed on a different port before this is safe to run for real.
**Port:** 7704

## Operations
- **accounts.list** (`list`) — GET /api/accounts — list all registered provider accounts and their last known usage
- **accounts.add** (`add`) — POST /api/accounts — register a new account — session/cookie reference stored via cos/vaultd
- **accounts.remove** (`remove`) — DELETE /api/accounts — remove an account and revoke its vault secret
- **accounts.usage** (`usage`) — GET /api/accounts/usage — report last known usage percentage for one account
- **accounts.usage-report** (`report-usage`) — POST /api/accounts/usage-report — record a usage observation for an account
- **accounts.route** (`route`) — POST /api/accounts/route — dynamic usage routing — best available account for a provider, under threshold
